description.value: Sahali Liquor Store is a private bottle shop located behind the Sahali Mall in Kamloops, operated by the adjacent Fox N Hounds Pub. It stocks 28 fully loaded cooler doors of cold beer, cider, and craft brews alongside wines, spirits, and BC VQA selections, making it a convenient cold-drink stop for cyclists passing through the city. The store also offers a call-ahead cold delivery service and a loyalty program shared with the neighbouring pub.
